faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: The essentials to know before you begin.

items.question: What is Il Budget degli Sposi?
items.answer: It is a web application for organizing the budget, guests, tasks, suppliers and documents related to your wedding.

items.question: Do I need to install anything?
items.answer: No. You can use it directly in a browser on computers, tablets and smartphones.

items.question: Can I edit information later?
items.answer: Yes. Your project information can be updated throughout the planning process.

items.question: Can I manage budget and guests together?
items.answer: Yes. Budget, guests and the other available areas are part of the same workspace.

items.question: How is my data handled?
items.answer: Access to personal areas requires authentication. See the Privacy Policy for details about processing and your rights.
